question: Has Farm Naturelle been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Farm Naturelle now?
markdown:
Farm Naturelle has not been acquired by or merged with another company
. It remains an independent brand owned and managed by its original founders,
Mr. Rajneesh Chawla
and
Mrs. Suman Chawla
, operating under their corporate entity
Holiorgo Farm Naturelle India Private Limited
(and registered under
Farm Natural Produce
) based in Gurugram, Haryana.
